stem_md: 均匀心形线 $r=a(1+\cos\theta)\ (a>0)$（线密度为常数 $\rho_0$）形状的构件的质心坐标是（ ）
analysis_md:
解答 设全弧的质心坐标为 $(\bar{x},\bar{y})$，显然 $\bar{y}=0$。

$$
\begin{aligned}
\bar{x}
&=\frac{\oint_L\rho_0x\,ds}{M}
=\frac{\oint_L\rho_0x\,ds}{\oint_L\rho_0\,ds}\\
&=\frac{\displaystyle\int_0^{2\pi}a(1+\cos\theta)\cos\theta\sqrt{[a(1+\cos\theta)]^2+[a(1+\cos\theta)']^2}\,d\theta}{\displaystyle\int_0^{2\pi}\sqrt{[a(1+\cos\theta)]^2+[a(1+\cos\theta)']^2}\,d\theta}\\
&=\frac{2a^2\displaystyle\int_0^{2\pi}(1+\cos\theta)\cos\theta\left|\cos\frac{\theta}{2}\right|\,d\theta}{2a\displaystyle\int_0^{2\pi}\left|\cos\frac{\theta}{2}\right|\,d\theta}\\
&=\frac{2a^2\displaystyle\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}(1+\cos\theta)\cos\theta\cos\frac{\theta}{2}\,d\theta}{8a}\\
&=\frac{a}{4}\displaystyle\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}(1+\cos\theta)\cos\theta\cos\frac{\theta}{2}\,d\theta
=\frac{a}{2}\displaystyle\int_0^{\pi}(1+\cos\theta)\cos\theta\cos\frac{\theta}{2}\,d\theta\\
&=\frac{a}{2}\displaystyle\int_0^{\pi}2\cos^2\frac{\theta}{2}\cos\theta\cos\frac{\theta}{2}\,d\theta\\
&=\frac{a}{2}\displaystyle\int_0^{\pi}2\cos^2\frac{\theta}{2}\left(2\cos^2\frac{\theta}{2}-1\right)\cos\frac{\theta}{2}\,d\theta\\
\xrightarrow{\theta=2t}
&=2a\displaystyle\int_0^{\pi/2}(2\cos^5t-\cos^3t)\,dt
=2a\left(2\cdot\frac{4}{5}\cdot\frac{2}{3}-\frac{2}{3}\right)
=\frac{4}{5}a
\end{aligned}
$$

所以全弧的质心坐标为 $\left(\frac{4}{5}a,0\right)$。

所以全弧质心的直角坐标为 $\left(\frac{4}{5}a,0\right)$，全弧质心对应的极坐标为 $\left(\frac{4}{5}a,0\right)$。
